title: Cool Flames Investigation
platform: International Space Station (Combustion Integrated Rack, Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus)
summary: 227 n-dodecane, n-dodecane/iso-dodecane and farnesane droplets (about 4-6 mm) were ignited aboard the ISS at 0.5-5 atm in O2/N2/He to study how the hot flame radiatively extinguishes and gives way to a low-temperature cool flame.
